title: SignalPayload
description: Per-source, per-version cache payload. Envelope is shared across modules; `facts` content shape is governed by the per-(vault, module) FactsSchema.

module.description: Module name that produced this payload. Must match a directory in <vault>/modules/.

source_id.description: Stable identifier for the source. Module-specific format (path for code, URL for youtube, etc.).

source_version.description: Version identifier opaque to the framework. Module-specific (SHA for code, transcript hash for youtube, etc.).

bridge_version.description: Framework version (semver) that produced this payload.

extracted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of extraction completion.

truncated.description: True if `notable` was truncated to fit the 100 KB envelope cap.

partial.description: True if this payload is a salvaged partial output per D9 (verdict will be 'error').

facts.description: Module-specific structured content. Shape governed by the active FactsSchema for (vault, module).
